purpose: Archive the already verified quantitative source tables underlying Figure S3 and the class-specific/within-group attribution results in Results 3.5. No images or large observation-level intermediates are bundled here.

files.role: Unchanged historical post-processing manifest; not a new execution record.

historical_large_input_identities.origin: Input hashes recorded by the unchanged historical analysis_manifest.json; these large inputs are not copied in this compact output archive.

methods.fixed_common_support: 714 observations from 21 sampling groups, with all four source predictors within their respective training marginal min-max ranges under both attenuation paths at all 10,25,50 percent path positions.
methods.path_position: Fraction of the specified logarithmic path toward its endpoint; not the fraction of emissions removed or elapsed calendar time.
methods.regional_estimate: Mean paired log-concentration change over retained observations, transformed as 100*expm1(mean_log_change). Regional points are observation-weighted, not sampling-group-equal.
methods.regional_bootstrap: 10000 whole-sampling-group resamples retaining the within-group observations and baseline-scenario pairs, conditional on the fixed models and source inventory.
methods.quartile_estimate: Within each sampling group represented in both pooled full-feature-distribution quartile bands, mean upper-band OOF SHAP minus mean lower-band OOF SHAP; equal weight over eligible sampling groups.
methods.quartile_bootstrap: 10000 resamples of the eligible group-level contrasts. Archived intervals preserve the historical RNG/computation stream, without rerunning or resetting it here.
methods.interval_type: Pointwise 95 percent percentile bootstrap intervals; not multiplicity-adjusted tests or complete model-estimation uncertainty.

boundaries: The complete compact summary files include sensitivity scopes/contrasts beyond the rows selected for Figure S3. The selectors above identify the reported panels exactly.
No exploratory attribution-knot/turning-point file, fitted threshold claim, raw XLSX, large observation-level CSV or figure image has been copied.

Quartile bands are descriptive feature-distribution bands, not physical release thresholds. SHAP contrasts are on the original Magnitude/Balance scales, not measured concentration changes or interfacial fluxes.
Regional group counts may overlap across sea regions and are not summed as independent groups.
No model retraining, primary SHAP recomputation or new bootstrap was performed during archival packaging.
New source-ratio diagnostic outputs, if added separately, are distinct from this reported-S3 archival record.
